text: Anya - starts @ Deloitte Mon. audit team, v nervous re commute. text her Sun nite good luck
Ivan lives Leeds now, Headingley, shares w/ 2 lads from uni. works for council - planning dept
Kwame = Arsenal season ticket holder, 20+ yrs. goes w/ his dad every home game. hates VAR w/ passion
Rebecca promoted - head of comms!! effective June 3rd. get her a card + something fizzy
Lola leaving the bakery Fri, last shift. drinks after @ the Crown, I'm going

coffee w/ Asha. her mum's retiring from nursing in a fortnight after 38 yrs on the same ward @ Whipps Cross. big do planned 5/14 at the cricket club - Asha organising the whole thing, bit frazzled tbh, venue keeps changing the menu + her brother Tunde useless. offered to do the playlist. need to chase Tunde re the slideshow photos by next Tues
Milan into bouldering lately - 3x/wk @ the Arch. wants own shoes, size 43 (gift idea?)
dentist Thurs 9.40. pick up dry cleaning after
Chris & Vanessa - both off to Lisbon this wknd, anniversary trip. 10 yrs married
Ignacio - knits!! socks mostly, doing a fair isle jumper atm. learnt from his abuela

Victor's last day @ Barclays tomorrow. redundancy not retirement, 19 yrs there, he's gutted. whole team got cut, his manager too. says he's 'fine' but clearly not - wife Rebecca worried he'll just sit on the sofa. call him next wk to check in, maybe take him for a pint Thurs. he's into fishing, could suggest a day at the lake
Ava lives w/ her sister Sofia in Brixton. Sofia's a paramedic, Ava does UX @ a fintech
Jakub - new role, team lead, from Tues. ask how 1st wk went by Fri
Aleksander Novak aka Olek - chess, plays online every nite, rated ~1900. into old Soviet endgame books
Miriam's husband retiring May 30. she's dreading him under her feet all day lol
Oisín plays trad fiddle in a session Weds nights, pub in Kilburn. also hurling w/ London club
Manon - interview @ Sciences Po Thurs, research asst post. v nervous. msg her Weds night
Lars - works offshore, 2 on 2 off, rig near Aberdeen. wife Nora + 2 kids in Stavanger
Sean got the job!! physio @ Spire, starts June 10. send congrats
Tunde & his partner moved to Croydon. he still commutes to Canary Wharf, 1hr+ each way

Kenji - vinyl collector, mainly 70s/80s Japanese city pop + some jazz fusion. hunting Tatsuro Yamashita 'For You' OG press, won't touch reissues. has a Technics deck he restored himself, spends Sat mornings in Soho record shops. birthday Aug 2 — hint hint, Sounds of the Universe voucher wd go down well
Luca's first day @ the restaurant was Sat. head chef shouted at him twice. follow up re how wk 2 going
Ayo - Man Utd fan (suffering), plays FIFA w/ his brother Ali most Sundays
Nasser Chen - accountant, works from home mostly, lives Reading, 3 kids, eldest at Exeter uni
Emily's dad - leaving do Fri 7pm, 40 yrs @ Royal Mail. she asked me to come, said yes

Anika runs the knitting circle Tues @ library. Rebecca + Miriam go too. Anika's daughter Adaeze helps w/ the tea. they're doing blankets for the neonatal unit this term, aiming for 50 by Xmas. Miriam does the crochet squares, Rebecca just gossips. Anika keen for me to join, apparently 'everyone starts w/ a scarf'
book MOT b4 Friday. car tax due 6/1
Ali → promotion to senior dev confirmed Mon. says raise is meh but title helps. congrats msg
Vanessa - dog Biscuit (cocker spaniel), 2. Biscuit's op on Weds, knee. she's worried sick. check in Thurs
Kwame's wife Asha pregnant, due Nov 9. 2nd baby. Kwame wants a girl this time
Sofia's brother Victor - pro photographer, weddings mostly. lives Bristol. useful for Chen wedding?
lunch w/ Ivan. his boss quitting end of month, Ivan might step up - interim mgr. decision Tues. ask him Wed what happened
Ignacio - thinks he's getting the boot. restructure mtgs all next wk, HR 1:1 on Monday. v stressed, not sleeping. msg Mon eve
Lola's band playing the Windmill Sat 4/26 - she's on bass. I'm going w/ Chris

Ava starts new job @ Monzo May 19, product designer, big step up from the agency. leaves current place May 9, has a wk off in between - going to Porto w/ Sofia, flights booked Sat 10th. she's nervous abt imposter syndrome, first in-house role. remember to ask abt both the trip and the 1st wk, maybe send a good luck msg the Sun before
Jakub - Polish, from Gdańsk, been here 12 yrs. works IT for Network Rail. married to Emily Hughes, met at uni
running club tonight cancelled - rain. try Thurs instead
Rebecca + husband Tom - painting, oils, did a course in Cornwall last summer. she's v good, he's v not
Adaeze - started @ Unilever 2 wks ago, graduate scheme, marketing rotation. loves it so far. her mum told me, so proud
Milan's stag do was meant to be Prague next wknd - off, wedding postponed. his fiancee's dad in hospital

Nora - retired teacher, taught French 30 yrs @ St Aidan's. lives on her own in Harrogate since husband died 2 yrs ago. son Lars visits monthly, daughter in Canada. loves crosswords, does the Times cryptic in pen every morning. walks her terrier Pip twice a day, Pip is 14 and slowing down
Kenji Suzuki - new job @ Sony from Oct 1!! audio engineering. moving to Woking in Sept for it. I said I'd help w/ van Sat 9/20
talked to Anya after wk 1 @ Deloitte. long hrs but nice team. manager Kim v supportive. she's fine. don't need to chase
Oisín's sister Manon (half-sister, French side) - starts PhD @ Edinburgh in Sept, linguistics. he's thrilled
Tunde - cycles, Brompton commuter + road bike wknds. did Ride London last yr. wants to do Etape next July

Chris - leaving the police after 22 yrs, retiring Aug 15, detective sergeant. party at the rugby club the Sat after, Vanessa organising. need to get a card everyone can sign + chip in for a gift - he's mentioned wanting a smoker for bbqs, offset one. ask Ignacio if he's in for the collection, deadline Aug 1
Asha - gardener, allotment in Walthamstow. grows chillies, 30+ varieties
ring Luca's mum back abt Sunday lunch
Victor Adeyemi - Victor's dad - retired GP, plays golf twice a wk. lives Surrey. Victor says he's v competitive, cheats at scrabble
Sean's partner Ali - nurse, nights @ St Thomas'. they live Clapham, flat above a launderette
Lars plays in a Hearthstone league?? online, Thurs nights. also builds Warhammer, Space Wolves army, huge

call w/ Miriam - her son Ayo's driving test Fri morning 8.30, 3rd attempt. he's a wreck, failed last time on a roundabout. she's taking him out every evening this wk to practise. text Ayo Thurs nite good luck, and ask Miriam Sat how it went
emailed Emily re reference. she's applying for deputy head, interview May 22. write ref by Mon
Nasser - Liverpool fan, also coaches his son's u10 team Saturdays. kid = Omar, striker apparently
Anika's husband Ivan works @ the BBC, sound engineer, Radio 4. they live Muswell Hill w/ 2 cats
Sofia mentioned her dad's 60th next Sat - she's doing a surprise at a Greek place in Palmers Green. I'm bringing a cake, she asked
Ivan Kim (Vanya) - neighbour, no.14. back from Seoul last wk, wedding there. jet lag brutal. lend him the hedge trimmer back

Kwame's 1st day as deputy store mgr @ Tesco Extra was yesterday. said it was chaos - 3 call-ins + a till broke. sounded knackered. message him tmrw to see if day 2 better, and bring him the leftover jollof Sat

Kwame's 1st day as deputy store mgr @ Tesco Extra was yesterday. said it was chaos - 3 call-ins + a till broke + someone fainted in the queue. sounded knackered but weirdly happy. his old boss Ali moved to Lidl last month so Kwame's kind of on his own. message him tmrw to see if day 2 better, and bring him the leftover jollof Sat

Ava, Emily, Chris - all into board games. game nite @ mine Fri 12th? Ava loves Wingspan, Chris only plays Catan + sulks if he loses. Emily paints minis for Gloomhaven, v detailed. Emily's bday 6/18 - she's after the Wingspan expansion, oceania one. order it by 6/10
